description: 5 V WS2812B data from an on-board driver through the series termination, a JST PH connector and 0/1/3 m of 24 AWG lead into the first pixel's DIN.

stimulus.kind: one rising and one falling edge (KIBIS RECTDRIVER n=1)
stimulus.note: Each edge gets its own window of base + 10 x cable delay (>= 5 source round trips, 33 ohm mismatch settles to < 1 %); the pulse is high for exactly one window.

overshoot_v.why: report only until the via/clamp models are calibrated

undershoot_v.why: report only until the via/clamp models are calibrated

ringback_margin_v.why: report only (a ringback into the band is already a nonmonotonic edge)

justification: Levels are the nominal rails 0 V and the corner rail (receiver VDD tracks the driver rail). 10-90 % <= 25 ns is 10 % of the classic WS2812B minimum T0H (0.4 us - 150 ns = 250 ns). A monotonic pass through VIL = 0.3 VDD and VIH = 0.7 VDD (one crossing of each per edge) is required. Overshoot/undershoot are compared with the WS2812B input abs-max (VDD + 0.5 V / -0.5 V) but only reported. Measured at the first pixel's DIN: at the connector a cable reflection makes a staircase whose 10-90 % time is not what the pixel sees.
corner_note: Every driver corner x cable length; lengths > 0 also sweep the cable impedance (nominal first, then the cable's z0_range_ohm corners): 3 + 2 x 3 x 3 = 21 decks per requirement. Pre-layout placement estimates use the nominal impedance only (report only).
